extracted.intended_audience: general readers and historians of Napoleonic-era France (French-speaking)
extracted.subtask_description: Full text (French) of Marshal Marmont's memoirs (Tome 3, Livre dixième) recounting military, administrative, and social matters in Dalmatia and the Adriatic during 1806–1807. This is a primary-source narrative rather than a guideline or evaluation rubric.
